claim: A Direct Connect dedicated connection supports at most 51 virtual interfaces in total, counting the transit virtual interfaces; this limit cannot be increased.
question: How many virtual interfaces in total can one dedicated connection have, transit included?

evidence.quote: | Private or public virtual interfaces per Direct Connect dedicated connection and transit virtual interfaces per Direct Connect dedicated connection | 51 | When AWS Direct Connect support for Amazon VPC Transit Gateways was launched, a quota of one (1) transit virtual interface was added to the quota of 50 private or public virtual interfaces per dedicated connection. The number of transit virtual interfaces allowed is now four (4) and is counted against the maximum of 51 virtual interfaces per dedicated connection. This limit cannot be increased. |
You can create up to 51 virtual interfaces per 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, or 400 Gbps dedicated connection inclusive of the transit virtual interface.

claim: A link aggregation group supports at most 51 virtual interfaces, with up to four of them transit virtual interfaces; this limit cannot be increased.
question: How many virtual interfaces can one LAG have?

evidence.quote: | Number of virtual interfaces per Link Aggregation Group (LAG) | 51 | When AWS Direct Connect support for Amazon VPC Transit Gateways was launched, a quota of one (1) transit virtual interface was added to the quota of 50 private or public virtual interfaces per LAG. The number of transit virtual interfaces allowed is now four (4) and is counted against the maximum of 51 virtual interfaces per LAG. This limit cannot be increased. |

claim: The SiteLink prefix limit is up to 1,000 each for IPv4 and IPv6, configured on a private or transit virtual interface using prefix controls; for more, contact your Solutions Architect or Technical Account Manager.
question: What is the SiteLink prefix limit?

values.display: up to 1,000 each for IPv4 and IPv6

qualifiers.scope: per private or transit virtual interface with SiteLink
qualifiers.condition: configured using prefix controls, which are not examinable yet

evidence.quote: | SiteLink prefix limit | Up to 1,000 each for IPv4 and IPv6, configured on your private or transit virtual interface [using prefix controls](prefix-controls.md). | Contact your Solutions Architect (SA) or Technical Account Manager (TAM) for further assistance. |
